caption:
Old Cuttack at 5 PM doesn’t need a production designer. 

Spent the evening squeezed between 19th-century wooden doors and a canopy of tangled black cables. You can't replicate this damp, faded texture on a studio floor. This is exactly where our episode three chase sequence begins. 

Which frame has the most grit—1, 2, or 3?

topic: Scouting locations in the narrow alleys of Old Cuttack at dusk
format: Carousel of gritty, unedited phone photos of decaying wooden doorways and tangled overhead cables
